drafts.text:
Under my NY open post, two traders told me the same story from opposite ends.
One took $100 and walked, wishing he'd held.
One got nervous up $110 on a 5k, wishing he'd waited for $200.
I did both in the same week.
Nobody has a hold problem or a cut problem. We fix the last mistake and walk straight into the opposite one.
Which one hurt you more this week?
drafts.source: Oct 21 NY open replies (@RichBroker101, @R3G5B7) + Jesus's own Oct 19 'let it run reverses, secure early flies' post.
drafts.why: The account's strongest format, no brackets, and three independent traders now back the 'last feeling decides the exit' idea. Confirm 'I did both in the same week' (his Oct 18 and Oct 19 posts say so).
drafts.why_es: El formato más fuerte de la cuenta, sin corchetes, y tres traders independientes respaldan ya la idea de que 'el último sentimiento decide la salida'. Confirma 'I did both in the same week' (tus posts del 18 y 19 oct lo dicen).

drafts.text:
I blamed the spread when my pass target didn't fill.
Then someone explained that a wick can print on a single trade without the book ever reaching that price.
So the wick never promised me a fill. I built a plan around a price I couldn't actually trade.
Next target goes where the book is, not where the wick goes.
drafts.source: @0xDevin_'s reply on the Oct 23 wick post (888 views): a wick can print on one trade without the book reaching that price.
drafts.why: Sequel to the 7.3K post that turns outside blame back into the account's core self-accountability voice, and gives readers something usable. Reply to @0xDevin_ first.
drafts.why_es: Secuela del post de 7.3K que devuelve la culpa externa a la voz central de autorresponsabilidad de la cuenta y le da al lector algo útil. Responde primero a @0xDevin_.

drafts.text:
A stranger asked me under my payout post which rule I'm tightening first.
Two payouts in nine days, $1,429.63 and $1,929.77, and I hadn't answered him.
[The rule: ___ ]
If I can't name it, the payout isn't progress. It's luck with a certificate.
drafts.source: @dctrades22's question on the Oct 25 payout post (unanswered) + the two real payouts (Oct 16 and Oct 25).
drafts.why: Audience-sourced, real numbers, and the only draft that needs his actual rule. Cut the bracket line if he does not have one.
drafts.why_es: Sacado de la audiencia, números reales, y el único draft que necesita su regla real. Quita la línea del corchete si aún no tiene una.

hookBank.hook: Right now I feel like shit.
It's crazy how the mind works in trading...
Yesterday I posted that I had just passed 10 accounts...
Trading is hard. The mental part is harder.
I can read price. I struggle to read myself.
My 100k Eval so far: Green day. Red day...
Passing an eval isn't the hard part for me.

hookNote: Hooks that hit are short, simple, present-tense, and clear on line one. Save irony for later lines.
hookNote_es: Los ganchos que pegan son cortos, simples, en presente y claros en la primera línea. Guarda la ironía para las líneas siguientes.
